verdict.rationale: Omarchy is an AI-forward Linux distro that bundles agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) and sets up a default agent, so asking about MCP-client plug-in support is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP servers or tool plug-in configuration, whether by Omarchy itself or by its bundled agents. Shipping third-party agents and agent skills is adjacent and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
